articles.title: UK crypto trader says almost $800,000 lost in knife assault as wrench attacks proliferate
articles.snippet: A crypto trader in the U.K. claimed masked intruders stole nearly $800,000 in cryptocurrency at knifepoint, furthering concerns of "wrench attacks" spreading in the country.

articles.title: Stacks' STX, a Bitcoin layer-2 token, has surged by 50% in four weeks
Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.snippet: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

articles.title: Aptos rolls out Encrypted Mempool to curb frontrunning, sandwich attacks
articles.snippet: The optional feature hides transaction details until their order is finalized, preventing bots from exploiting pending trades.

articles.title: ‘Leave’: Crypto Backlash Over French Proposal to Report Wallets Over $112K
articles.snippet: The proposal would require crypto owners to report holdings over €100,000, sparking concerns following a wave of "wrench attacks" in France.
